methodology: This adapter parses Wikipedia's annual World's Billionaires tables, reads the age and net-worth columns, and selects the youngest distinct people who appear in the annual top-10 snapshots. The latest frame is a bootstrap comparison frame using each selected person's youngest observed table appearance.
